title: Linked List Cycle Detection
description: Implement a function to detect if a linked list contains a cycle.

run_code.python:
class ListNode:
    def init(self, val=0):
        self.val = val
        self.next = None

def build_linked_list(arr):
    if not arr:
        return None
    head = ListNode(arr[0])
    current = head
    for val in arr[1:]:
        current.next = ListNode(val)
        current = current.next
    return head

def add_cycle(head, pos):
    if pos == -1:
        return head
    cycle_node = None
    current = head
    index = 0
    while current.next:
        if index == pos:
            cycle_node = current
        current = current.next
        index += 1
    current.next = cycle_node
    return head

import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split("\n")

arr = list(map(int, lines[0].split()))
pos = int(lines[1])

head = build_linked_list(arr)
head = add_cycle(head, pos)

print(str(hasCycle(head)).lower())

title: LRU Cache Design
description: Design and implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache.
input:
10
LRUCache 2
put 1 1
put 2 2
get 1
put 3 3
get 2
put 4 4
get 1
get 3
get 4

run_code.python:
import sys

lines = sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
n = int(lines[0])
lru = None
results = []

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    parts = lines[i].split()
    op = parts[0]

    if op == "LRUCache":
        capacity = int(parts[1])
        lru = LRUCache(capacity)
        results.append("null")

    elif op == "put":
        key = int(parts[1])
        value = int(parts[2])
        lru.put(key, value)
        results.append("null")

    elif op == "get":
        key = int(parts[1])
        results.append(str(lru.get(key)))

print(" ".join(results))

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Given the root of a binary tree, determine if it is a valid binary search tree (BST).

run_code.python:
import sys

class TreeNode:
    def init(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def build_tree(values):
    if not values or values[0] == 'null':
        return None

    root = TreeNode(int(values[0]))
    queue = [root]
    i = 1

    while queue and i < len(values):
        node = queue.pop(0)

        if i < len(values) and values[i] != 'null':
            node.left = TreeNode(int(values[i]))
            queue.append(node.left)
        i += 1

        if i < len(values) and values[i] != 'null':
            node.right = TreeNode(int(values[i]))
            queue.append(node.right)
        i += 1

    return root

values = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
root = build_tree(values)


result = isValidBST(root)

print(str(result))
